description: This blueprint represents a Google Cloud Subscription
title: Google Cloud Subscription

pushConfig.title: Push Configuration
pushConfig.description: The ingestion configuration for this subscription

ackDeadlineSeconds.title: Ack Deadline Seconds
ackDeadlineSeconds.description: The maximum time after receiving a message that the subscriber should acknowledge the message

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: A set of key/value label pairs to assign to this subscription

retainAckedMessages.title: Retain Acked Messages
retainAckedMessages.description: Indicates whether to retain acknowledged messages

messageRetentionDuration.title: Message Retention Duration
messageRetentionDuration.description: How long to retain unacknowledged messages in the subscription's backlog

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A filter expression that determines which messages should be delivered to the subscriber

description: This blueprint represents a single resource-level GCP IAM allow-policy binding: one member granted one role on one resource. Grants set on a folder or organization are not included, and inherited access is not resolved.
title: GCP IAM Policy Binding

role.title: Role
role.description: The IAM role granted, e.g. roles/storage.objectViewer

member.title: Member
member.description: The principal the role is granted to, e.g. serviceAccount:a@b.iam.gserviceaccount.com

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Full resource name the policy is attached to

assetType.title: Asset Type
assetType.description: GCP asset type of the resource, e.g. iam.googleapis.com/ServiceAccount

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: The IAM condition attached to this binding, if any
